description: BB84: Alice encodes bit 1 in the X (diagonal) basis, Bob measures in the X basis and must read 1.
prompt: Write a Python function named build_circuit() that takes no arguments and returns a qiskit QuantumCircuit with exactly 1 qubit. It simulates one round of the BB84 protocol: Alice encodes the bit 1 in the diagonal (X) basis, so the qubit is prepared in the state |->. Bob then measures this qubit in the same diagonal (X) basis and stores the result in a classical bit, where the outcome |+> is read as 0 and |-> is read as 1. Use only the qiskit package. Return the circuit; do not run it. Answer with the code only.
